pages.text: With Patchouli, there are five more red books: handbooks with one page per block, item or function. Each page has a short description, the crafting recipe and an example.

$(li)$(l)Data$(): crafted from a book and a type base$(li)$(l)Statements$(): a book and a structural base$(li)$(l)Tools$(): a book and a wrench$(li)$(l)Triggers$(): a book and a trigger block$(li)$(l)Functions$(): a book and a FUNCTION block
